zh.title: Aster
zh.meta_description: Aster，Android 上的代码编辑、智能协作与交互终端工作台。
zh.privacy_updated: 更新于 2026 年 11 月 7 日
zh.privacy_site: 官网不使用第三方统计、广告或远程字体。服务器可能记录请求路径、来源 IP 和访问时间，用于维护服务。APK 下载请求经过 gh-proxy.org 与 GitHub。
zh.privacy_language: 页面会根据浏览器或设备语言选择中文或英文。手动选择的语言仅保存在当前浏览器的本地存储中，用于下次访问时保留偏好；不会用于统计或广告。浏览器禁用本地存储时，仍可通过语言链接切换页面。
zh.privacy_client: 账户登录、积分和用量在 Aster App 内管理。使用模型时，对话、所选项目内容及工具结果会发送给所用服务。自定义模型请求发往你配置的供应商；图片输入同样遵循所选供应商的数据政策。
zh.privacy_terminal: 使用 Aster 远程终端 MCP 时，命令在远程服务器执行，而不是在手机上执行。命令、输入和终端输出会传送到该服务；终端工作区文件及近期历史保存在服务器。请勿在不受信任的会话中输入密码、密钥或其他敏感内容。
zh.privacy_history: 终端历史可在服务重启后保留，但正在运行的终端进程不会因此恢复。服务访问需要认证；请妥善保管访问凭据。
zh.privacy_choices: 请只提供愿意交给对应服务处理的内容。你可以在 App 内选择模型、管理项目上下文或退出账户。
zh.scene_label: 可旋转缩放的四部手机模型
zh.scene_instructions: 拖动旋转，滚轮或双指缩放。长按背景可淡化界面、移除柔焦并提高模型渲染清晰度，松开恢复。方向键旋转，加减号缩放，空格暂停，I 切换清晰查看，R 重置，Escape 退出查看。
zh.license_intro: Aster 建立在多个开源项目之上。下列清单依据仓库内的第三方声明、来源记录与许可证文件整理；原始许可及其例外条款优先适用。
zh.license_warning: 许可状态说明：仓库的第三方声明仍将组合分发条款与完整对应源码列为发布审查事项。本页仅披露现有记录，不构成“全部许可已审清”的保证。根 LICENSE 是保留的 Termux 历史声明，不覆盖其他组件的条款。
zh.license_columns: 组件|版本 / 范围|许可|来源与声明
zh.license_web_text: Three.js r187（0.187.0），MIT。网站随附完整许可文本及 npm 包完整性记录。四部手机为自主绘制的概念化轮廓模型，不是品牌官方 3D 资产，也不表示厂商合作或背书。屏幕来自本次设计提供的 Aster 界面截图；搜索产品图仅供外观研究，不随网站分发。

en.title: Aster
en.meta_description: Aster: code editing, AI collaboration and an interactive terminal in one Android workspace.
en.privacy_site: This website uses no third-party analytics, advertising, or remote fonts. The server may log request paths, source IP addresses, and access times to maintain the service. APK download requests pass through gh-proxy.org and GitHub.
en.privacy_language: The page chooses Chinese or English based on your browser or device language. A manual language choice is saved only in this browser's local storage to remember your preference on future visits; it is not used for analytics or advertising. You can still switch languages using the language links when local storage is disabled.
en.privacy_client: Account sign-in, credits, and usage are managed within the Aster app. When you use a model, your conversation, selected project content, and tool results are sent to that service. Custom model requests go to the provider you configure. Image inputs are also subject to the selected provider's data policy.
en.privacy_terminal: When you use Aster's remote terminal MCP, commands run on a remote server rather than on your phone. Commands, input, and terminal output are sent to that service. Terminal workspace files and recent history are stored on the server. Do not enter passwords, keys, or other sensitive information in untrusted sessions.
en.privacy_history: Terminal history may persist after a service restart, but running terminal processes are not restored. Access to the service requires authentication. Keep your access credentials secure.
en.privacy_choices: Only share content you are willing to have the relevant service process. You can choose a model, manage project context, or sign out in the app.
en.scene_instructions: Drag to rotate; scroll or pinch to zoom. Hold the background to fade the interface, remove soft focus and render the models at higher resolution. Release to restore. Arrow keys rotate, plus/minus zoom, Space pauses, I toggles sharp inspection, R resets and Escape exits inspection.
en.license_intro: Aster is built on open-source work. This inventory follows the notices, provenance records and license files in the repository. Original terms and their exceptions remain authoritative.
en.license_warning: License status: the repository still identifies combined distribution terms and complete corresponding source as release-review items. This page discloses the retained records; it is not a claim of complete license clearance. The root LICENSE is a historical Termux notice, not an override of other component terms.
en.license_web_text: Three.js r187 (0.187.0), MIT. The full license and npm integrity record are hosted with this website. The four devices are independently drawn, conceptual silhouette models, not official brand 3D assets or endorsements. Screens use the Aster screenshots supplied for this design. Product-search images were used only for visual research and are not distributed with the site.
